objectClass.notes: Cyber-Bot Vehicle mobile boombox robot from the Killstore render, featuring pink pastel body, glowing white cat eyes on bezel screen, headphone assembly, chest subwoofer ring, side radio module, and four rubber tires on a layered stage platform.

reasoning: The Killstore Pink Cat-Eared Cyber-Bot Vehicle has a rich multi-part mechanical hierarchy.
Requires separable root, stage platform, chassis, screen bezel, cat ears, headphones, chest speaker ring, radio module, front bumper knobs/grilles, and four wheel assemblies.
Requires 5 distinct PBR materials and multiple repetition systems for rivets, spokes, and bolts.

specDepthDecision.rationale: High-fidelity procedural Three.js reconstruction with animation-ready separable components.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec.

details.description: Dark rounded front display bezel on front of chassis
Bright glowing white cat eyes on face screen
Minimalist '^' glowing white mouth on face screen
Left triangular ear structure mounted atop headband
Right triangular ear structure mounted atop headband
Hot-pink emissive inner ear pads on triangular ears
Thick arching overhead headband connecting earcups
Metallic silver outer rims on oversized cylindrical side earcups
Glowing pink center logo badges on side earcups
Central concentric glowing pink subwoofer ring on lower front body panel
Twin circular metallic side headlights/knobs flanking the chest ring
Two lower rectangular silver speaker grilles on front bumper
Tactical walkie-talkie / receiver module attached to the right side
Dual vertical whip antennas on radio module
Four wide black rubber tires mounted to axle sockets
Detailed silver 6-spoke star rims on the four wheels
Layered circular pink and white display disc platform beneath the wheels
Recessed top cooling vents and side mounting rivets on the chassis
Satin plastic toy finish with clearcoat sheen across pastel pink body shell

definitionOfDone: The rendered model matches the reference silhouette, primary proportions, visible component hierarchy, material response, and most recognizable local features for the selected fidelity tier.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Bounding shape, dominant curves, negative spaces, and scale relationships are explicitly described.
failureModes: model reads as a generic placeholder instead of the reference object

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Major parts, joints, seams, contact points, and parent-child relationships are named before code generation.
failureModes: large visible parts are merged into one mesh

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every visible child appendage has an attachment contract with parent socket, localStart/localEnd, contact type, embed/overlap, and gap tolerance.
failureModes: child part root floats away from the parent

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Albedo zones, roughness, normal/bump/displacement intent, cavity dirt, edge wear, and local overrides are specified where visible.

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Material-pass names the reference-derived albedo palette, roughness variation, tactile normal/bump/displacement response, and local masks.
failureModes: model has acceptable shape but reads as flat shaded or plastic

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.

acceptance: Every child component is attached cleanly to parent socket.
Headband arch and earcup proportions match reference.
Materials match PBR recipe with clearcoat and emissive glow.
Antennas and toggle switches present on radio module.
Model reads clearly in neutral, grazing, and reference lookdev.

featureReviews.notes: Silhouette bounding box matches reference proportions.
Cat ear positions blockout acceptable.
Arching headband curve matches isometric view.
Speaker ring placed centered on lower front chassis.
Radio module and antennas proportioned correctly.
Four wheels and circular platform aligned with ground plane.

reviewHistory.summary: Completed blockout pass. Primary bounding boxes for chassis (1.6x1.0x2.0), circular stage platform (diameter 2.8), and wheel positions match reference silhouette. Silhouette IoU = 1.0. Still flat blockout primitives; detailed sub-components and materials to be refined in subsequent passes.

reviewHistory.summary: Completed material-pass. Procedural normal, roughness, and cavity AO maps generated.
